comment: Conformance corpus for the dynamics document's schema-vs-merge split (QA finding dynamics-schema-merge-differential-battery, issue #1040). Each case under cases/ pins two verdicts: 'schema' — whether the emitted dcs-plant-server --dynamics-schema document validates it — and 'merge' — whether dcs-plant-server <model> --check-dynamics accepts it — plus the model the merge runs against and the divergence class the case pins. The filename's '<schema>-<merge>' prefix must restate both verdicts. crates/dcs-plant/tests/dynamics_corpus.rs enforces every pin and proves each merge accept serves a runnable plant. A file that is not JSON at all fails both layers before either sees a document.

cases.note: The bool-gated pump-draw loop: two bool_flow draws gated on the out commands, a flow_sum balance, and the well integrator — the served plant must step.
The threshold-closed protection loop: a float input driving a bool contact that gates an emergency draw.
The single first-order lag closing the tank level on the valve command — the checked-in tank_loop_dynamics document.
The empty declaration list merges to the untouched channel map; the served plant must still step.

The self-point boundary the QA battery found undocumented: a lag reading and driving one point is legal — both legs want float and the element simply holds its input — and must produce a runnable plant. Only the bool_flow/threshold self-points, where the legs' kinds can never agree, are refused.

The one documented schema-FAIL/merge-PASS class: an unknown field inside an element — here a misspelled 'time_constnt' — trips additionalProperties:false while serde silently ignores it, so the merge accepts and the plant must run.
An output naming a point the model binds nowhere (UnknownPoint) — point references are beyond the schema vocabulary.
A bool_flow gate reading a float point (ElementGateKind) — the kind each leg requires is checked at merge, not in the schema.
A threshold contact driving a float point (ElementContactKind).
A threshold whose on/off bounds are equal declares no hysteresis band (NonPositiveBand) — comparing two fields is beyond the schema vocabulary.
1e999 is valid JSON grammar the schema accepts as a number; the document's serde reader rejects the out-of-range literal before validation runs.
The lexical integer/float distinction: 11.0 is mathematically an integer to the schema but a float the u64 serde reader rejects.
A point id past u64::MAX: the schema's id carries no maximum, the serde reader rejects the out-of-range number.
Two distinct elements driving one point (ConflictingDriver) — uniqueItems only catches identical elements, so the merge owns the general rule.
A threshold driving a pump's bool out command (ElementOutputDirection) — the served map's directions are invisible to the schema.

Must-reject since #957: a bool_flow whose gate and output name one bool point — the gate leg wants bool, the output leg float, so no point kind satisfies both and the merge refuses (ElementPointKind) instead of serving a plant that panicked its first step.
Must-reject since #957: a threshold reading and driving one bool point — the input leg wants float — refused at merge (ElementPointKind) even though the driven direction is a legal in point.
An element tag outside the vocabulary: additionalProperties:false rejects the wrapper and serde rejects the unknown variant — a schema rejection that implies merge rejection.
A negative amplitude: the schema's nonnegative bound rejects it and the merge agrees (InvalidAmplitude).
Two identical elements: uniqueItems rejects the list and the merge rejects the second element's driven point (ConflictingDriver) — the schema approximation of the conflict rule.
Not JSON at all — neither layer sees a document: the schema has nothing to validate and the merge's parse reports the file.
